## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the smallest implemented change.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] UI or localization
- [ ] Tests or build tooling
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Release or maintenance

## Verification

List the exact commands and manual checks performed.

```text
command / check → result
```

## Visual evidence

For visible changes, attach before/after screenshots covering normal and narrow widths. Generate repository screenshots only with the isolated workflow in `docs/readme-screenshots.md`.

## Data and privacy

- [ ] Existing local history, Templates, preferences, and entitlement state are preserved.
- [ ] No real clipboard contents, credentials, tokens, customer data, Realm files, signing keys, or TCC databases are included.
- [ ] New logging avoids clipboard payloads and other sensitive values.

## Scope

- [ ] The pull request is focused and contains no unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Upstream attribution and license notices remain intact.
- [ ] Anything not verified is stated explicitly.
